$comment: U-163, first leaf of U-140: the continuous R0-R7 ridge shelf of construction specification sections 2.2, 3.2 and 6.1. An 8 m stepped shelf cut into the T-E ridge body, its exact flat landings and R3 combat shelf, with barrier rock on both sides. Temporary caps close the unbuilt V1-V3 bay fronts (U-141) and R7's bridge mouth (U-164). The R7b bridge, R8/R9 descent, huts, survey post and ridge cover are U-164/U-165; this is not a campaign registry entry.

V2's fan reaches the R4 landing's west edge; closed at barrier height until U-141 builds the bay
V3's fans reach the R6 landing and the R6-R7 stair's west edge; closed at barrier height until U-141 builds the bay
R7's north edge is the future bridge approach; over the X4 apron the wall hangs above y14 so the 36 m apron stays clear
the R7 landing's north-east corner overhangs the X4 apron, which reaches its east edge north of z322.5; a hanging wall closes that drop until the bridge exists
